name: RELAY
tagline: Your job search should remember what you've done.
summary: A job-search review workspace that keeps research, application history, and exact accepted drafts together across your tools.
capabilities: Consolidate repeated posting URLs while preserving source history.
Keep interview notes and follow-ups without resetting application status.
Accept an exact draft; changing the wording requires review again.
Import a tracker CSV through explicit column mapping and a record preview. Source statuses remain research; existing Relay status and accepted drafts are preserved.

integrations.name: ChatGPT
integrations.description: Prepared prompts and JSON file handoffs for draft review.

integrations.name: Codex
integrations.description: Prepared prompts, validated draft files, or local drafting through the signed-in Codex CLI.

integrations.name: Obsidian
integrations.description: Selected research notes, version-bound draft notes, and job context exports.

integrations.name: Notion
integrations.description: Read-only research import through the local command connector.

integrations.name: Claude
integrations.description: Draft preparation through the Claude API with your own credentials.

integrations.name: Grok Bot
integrations.description: Validated research and draft file exchange in the Bot's VM.

integrations.name: Tracker CSV
integrations.description: Explicit column mapping and preview of a local comma-separated tracker file as research.

boundary: Integrations require explicit setup or file handoffs. Returned drafts require human review. No automatic application sending or background account sync is included.
openaiBoundary: ChatGPT uses a prompt/file handoff; Codex also supports a local CLI adapter. This release does not include a hosted ChatGPT app or MCP connection.
